<a id="page-auth"></a>
# Auth: signing users in

<a id="auth-when-to-use"></a>
## When to use

The `auth` feature library: signing app users in, up and out, and managing their account, with `${auth}` to show
who is signed in.

<a id="auth-minimal-example"></a>
## Minimal example

A sign-in form whose error appears in a text:

```json
{
  "schema": 4,
  "roots": ["signIn"],
  "nodes": {
    "signIn": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "slots": {"body": "col"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 320},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}]}
    },
    "col": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["email", "password", "error", "go"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 320}, "padding": 24},
      "props": {"spacing": 12}
    },
    "email": {
      "type": "textField",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": 56},
      "props": {"decoration": {"labelText": "Email"}, "keyboardType": "emailAddress"},
      "bind": {"props.initialValue": "${email}"}
    },
    "password": {
      "type": "textField",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": 56},
      "props": {"decoration": {"labelText": "Password"}, "obscureText": true},
      "bind": {"props.initialValue": "${password}"}
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 18}},
      "props": {"text": "${authError}", "style": {"fontSize": 13, "color": "#FFDC2626"}},
      "bind": {"visible": "${= authError != ''}"}
    },
    "go": {
      "type": "filledButton",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": 48},
      "props": {"label": "Sign in", "style": {"backgroundColor": "#FF2563EB", "foregroundColor": "#FFFFFFFF"}},
      "actions": [
        {
          "trigger": {"type": "click"},
          "actions": [
            {
              "type": "auth",
              "operation": "signIn",
              "email": "${email}",
              "password": "${password}",
              "errorVariable": "authError"
            },
            {"type": "navigate", "to": "signIn", "mode": "pop"}
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "variables": {
    "signIn": [
      {"name": "email", "type": "text", "value": ""},
      {"name": "password", "type": "text", "value": ""},
      {"name": "authError", "type": "text", "value": ""}
    ]
  }
}
```

<a id="auth-reference"></a>
## Reference

<a id="action-auth"></a>
### `auth` (action): Auth

Signs app users in, up and out, and manages their account. A failure's message goes in `errorVariable` (and stops the chain).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | [AuthOperation](values.md#enum-AuthOperation) | `"signIn"` |  |  |
| `email` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `password` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `displayName` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `photoUrl` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `currentPassword` | String | `""` |  | Re-authenticates first (change password, delete account). |
| `errorVariable` | String | `""` |  | Gets a failure's message. |

<a id="auth-patterns"></a>
## Patterns

<a id="auth-show-the-signed-in-user"></a>
### Show the signed-in user

`${auth.isSignedIn}`, `${auth.email}`, `${auth.displayName}`, `${auth.initial}`, `${auth.role}` bind like any value: a header shows "Sign in" or
the user's name by `visible` bindings on `${auth.isSignedIn}`.

<a id="auth-errors"></a>
### Errors

A failure's message goes in `errorVariable` and stops the chain: actions after `auth` run only on success.

<a id="auth-pitfalls"></a>
## Pitfalls

- Not in the agent trust profile at run time.
- Keep the password in a variable only as long as the form needs it.
